rows.business_definition: Canonical internal worker identifier used to join worker-scoped records within a snapshot. Must be stable within the pilot run.
rows.derivation_logic: Prefer Workday worker identifier; if payroll has separate person key, store as payroll_worker_id and map to worker_id via approved crosswalk. worker_id must be unique per snapshot.
rows.tolerance: 0 duplicates; 0 nulls; 100% join for in-scope workers
rows.failure_impact: Without a stable worker id no joins or per-worker explainability is possible. All downstream outputs invalid.
rows.access_control: Restricted: Payroll, HRIS, Reward, Legal, Privacy, Internal Audit (need-to-know). Mask in non-privileged views.
rows.retention_requirement: Pilot extracts retained per approved retention schedule; delete raw extracts per pilot policy; retain snapshot lineage + hashed references as evidence.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit access to worker-level identifiers; audit any changes to mapping crosswalk.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Purpose limitation: validation + compliance evidence only.
rows.change_control: Change requires HRIS owner + Payroll controls sign-off; privacy veto applies.

rows.business_definition: Native Workday worker/person identifier used for extraction and traceability.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; stored as source lineage key; must map 1:1 to worker_id within snapshot.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls; 0 duplicates
rows.failure_impact: Missing Workday id breaks HRIS lineage and impairs auditability.
rows.retention_requirement: As above; retain for audit lineage for pilot window.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit extraction and mapping rules version.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Do not repurpose for non-pilot analytics.

rows.business_definition: Native payroll worker/person identifier used for extraction and payroll-anchored reconciliation.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; map to worker_id via approved crosswalk; must be unique within payroll provider context.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls; 0 duplicates; >=99% join overall (per Validation Charter G7)
rows.failure_impact: Missing payroll id prevents payroll anchoring for remuneration truth.
rows.retention_requirement: As above; retain for audit lineage for pilot window.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit payroll extract lineage and mapping changes.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Payroll identifiers must not be shared outside approved access groups.

rows.business_definition: Worker employment status at snapshot effective date (e.g., active/terminated/leave) as used to include/exclude population.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday worker status at snapshot date; payroll used only to detect mismatches for active paid workers.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level comparison HRIS vs payroll-active indicator
rows.tolerance: Exact match for in-scope paid workers; exceptions must be coded
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect population inclusion/exclusion undermines compliance metrics and audit defensibility.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot as evidence.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit inclusion/exclusion decisions at run level.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Population rules must align to pilot scope lock (Validation Charter G1).
rows.change_control: HRIS owner + Legal review for rule change.

rows.business_definition: Employment type (e.g., employee/worker classification per HRIS) used for eligibility and required reporting segmentation where applicable.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday employment type; payroll used only as mismatch signal when a worker is paid as a different type. Canonicalize to controlled enum.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level reconciliation HRIS vs payroll worker type (when present)
rows.tolerance: Exact match when both present; missing for any in-scope worker is not allowed unless exception approved
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect employment type can lead to invalid in-scope population and defensibility gaps.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; purpose limitation applies.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit any overrides/corrections and their approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Population rules must align to pilot scope lock.
rows.change_control: HRIS owner + Legal review for rule change.

rows.business_definition: Contract type (e.g., permanent/fixed-term) used for eligibility and methodology segmentation where applicable.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday contract type; payroll used only for mismatch detection if present. Canonicalize to controlled enum.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level reconciliation HRIS vs payroll contract flags (when present)
rows.tolerance: Exact match when both present; missing for any in-scope worker is not allowed unless exception approved
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect contract type can cause defensibility issues and incorrect population segmentation.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; purpose limitation applies.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit any overrides/corrections and their approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Use only where explicitly required by methodology/pilot scope.
rows.change_control: HRIS owner + Legal review for rule change.

rows.business_definition: Employment start date used for eligibility/tenure rules if applicable in methodology.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; effective-dated; store as ISO date.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls for in-scope; valid date
rows.failure_impact: May affect eligibility/segmentation; usually not required for EU core metrics but may affect methodology sampling.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; follow pilot retention schedule.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit if used in methodology decisions.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Use only for defined methodology inputs; avoid unnecessary processing.

rows.business_definition: Employment end date for terminated workers used to determine in-scope period inclusion.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; nullable for active workers.
rows.tolerance: If status=terminated then end_date required; else nullable
rows.failure_impact: Wrong termination dating can bias inclusion and payroll-period reconciliation windows.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit population filter logic versions.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Purpose limitation as above.

rows.business_definition: Identifier for employment/assignment record when worker can have multiple concurrent assignments.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday assignment/position assignment key; payroll assignment key mapped where distinct. Must be unique per worker within snapshot when present.
rows.reconciliation_method: Join integrity at assignment grain (where payroll supports)
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls if multi-assignment in scope; uniqueness per worker
rows.failure_impact: Without assignment_id, pay and job attributes may be misattributed across concurrent roles.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; delete raw extracts per policy.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit mapping from payroll assignment identifiers.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Pilot scope must state whether multiple assignments are in scope.

rows.business_definition: Identifier of the employing legal entity used for reporting boundaries and payroll context.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday legal entity/company; payroll used for cross-check. Store both ids if differing and map via approved crosswalk.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level comparison HRIS vs payroll company
rows.tolerance: Exact match via crosswalk; 0 unmapped entities
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect legal entity breaks statutory scoping and payroll reconciliation boundaries.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; entity crosswalk retained as governance artifact.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit entity crosswalk changes and approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Entity mappings are controlled reference data; do not change without governance.

rows.business_definition: Country of employment/payroll context (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) used for reporting and overlay selection (later).
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday country of employment; payroll used for reconciliation. Canonicalize to ISO codes.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level comparison HRIS vs payroll country
rows.tolerance: Exact match after canonicalization; exceptions must be coded
rows.failure_impact: Wrong country drives wrong statutory overlay and invalid compliance outputs.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit canonicalization rules version.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: No country-specific logic in code; overlays come later.
rows.change_control: HRIS owner approval; Legal review if rules change.

rows.business_definition: Identifier for the payroll provider/system instance used in pilot (single provider expected).
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract or configured constant for the pilot payroll source; must be explicit per snapshot.
rows.tolerance: Exact match to pilot scope; single provider unless scope expanded
rows.failure_impact: If provider context is unclear, reconciliation and audits cannot anchor remuneration truth.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot metadata; aligns to audit evidence retention.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit any change to provider identification.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Provider identifiers are operationally sensitive.

rows.business_definition: Identifier for a payroll run (regular/off-cycle) used to reconcile paid amounts to payroll results.
rows.derivation_logic: Extract payroll run identifier per earning line or per run; link earning lines to run_id; if unavailable, use pay_period_id + offcycle_flag.
rows.reconciliation_method: Record-level reconciliation of earning lines to payroll run outputs
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls for included earning lines; 0 orphan run references
rows.failure_impact: Without payroll_run_id (or equivalent), off-cycle/retro handling and audit reconciliation are not defensible.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot for evidence; raw payroll reports retained per payroll controls policy.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit reconciliation evidence references.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Do not use payroll_run_id outside reconciliation/evidence generation.

rows.business_definition: Start date of the pay period used for period scoping and normalization.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from payroll calendar; cross-check against HRIS pay period config if present.
rows.tolerance: Exact match to payroll calendar
rows.failure_impact: Wrong periods invalidate pay aggregation and statutory timing.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot metadata.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit calendar version/reference used.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Period definitions must be payroll-anchored.

rows.business_definition: End date of the pay period used for period scoping and normalization.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from payroll calendar; cross-check if HRIS config exists.
rows.tolerance: Exact match to payroll calendar
rows.failure_impact: Wrong periods invalidate pay aggregation and statutory timing.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot metadata.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit calendar reference.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: As above.

rows.business_definition: Flag indicating off-cycle payroll run for earning lines included in the snapshot.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; default false for regular runs.
rows.tolerance: Must be present for every included earning line/run; if run is off-cycle then true; else false
rows.failure_impact: Off-cycle mislabeling can distort period allocation and reconciliation exception analysis and can hide material reconciliation exceptions.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit any derivation defaults.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Used for reconciliation and explainability only.

rows.business_definition: Identifier for the position/job instance (HR position management) used to join job attributes.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; effective-dated; must map to assignment_id when applicable.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls for in-scope; 0 orphan references
rows.failure_impact: Without position_id, job architecture cannot be traced and comparable grouping becomes unreliable.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit referential integrity results.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Job/position identifiers are HRIS lineage keys.

rows.business_definition: Worker job title at snapshot date used as an input to job normalization and category assignment.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday; normalize whitespace/case for canonical storage; retain raw_title in lineage if captured.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls for in-scope; normalization issues below agreed threshold
rows.failure_impact: Missing job title blocks category assignment and metrics gating.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; raw strings handled as PII.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit normalization rules version and any manual mappings.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Job titles may contain identifying free text; minimize exposure.
rows.change_control: Reward owner + HRIS owner approval for rule change.

rows.business_definition: Job family/classification as used by job architecture for grouping.
rows.derivation_logic: Prefer Workday job family if consistently maintained; else use reward/job architecture reference table. If not reliable, mark not-ready and do not use in pilot grouping.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level reconciliation HRIS vs reward reference
rows.tolerance: Exact match when present; else allowed null
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect family codes can misclassify comparable groups; treat as optional until proven reliable.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit reference table version used.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Do not infer family from title without approved methodology (H03).

rows.business_definition: Job level/grade used for comparability and methodology inputs (if included in pilot).
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday grade/level; cross-check against reward framework; canonicalize to stable codes.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level reconciliation HRIS vs reward grade
rows.tolerance: Exact match via mapping; 0 unmapped levels for in-scope
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect level undermines equal-pay defensibility and category assignment.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; mapping tables retained.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit mapping table changes and approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Level mapping is governed methodology input; changes require Legal awareness.
rows.change_control: Reward owner + Legal review for mapping changes.

rows.business_definition: Stable job code used for reference to job architecture catalog.
rows.derivation_logic: Prefer reward/job architecture catalog id when available; else use Workday job profile id. Must be stable and versioned.
rows.tolerance: 0 unmapped job codes if used; else nullable
rows.failure_impact: Missing job_code reduces traceability to job architecture catalog but may not block pilot if title+level sufficient.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit catalog version referenced.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Job catalogs may be proprietary.

rows.business_definition: FTE fraction used to normalize pay/hours where required.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday FTE; payroll used to reconcile if payroll stores standard hours/FTE. Store as decimal 0–1.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level comparison HRIS vs payroll FTE/standard-hours derived
rows.tolerance: Absolute difference <= 0.01 unless justified; exceptions coded
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect FTE breaks normalization and can materially change pay gap metrics.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit normalization and any imputation rules (imputation not allowed in v1).
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: No imputation without explicit approval and evidence.
rows.change_control: HRIS + Payroll controls sign-off for tolerance change.

rows.business_definition: Contracted standard hours per week used for normalization checks.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday; reconcile against payroll standard hours if present.
rows.tolerance: Exact match or within 0.5 hours/week depending on policy
rows.failure_impact: May affect normalization; optional until proven consistent.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit tolerance policy.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Use only if defined as methodology input.

rows.business_definition: Actual paid hours in the pay period (if used for hourly workers or normalization).
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract per worker per pay period; if not used, keep out of pilot-mandatory set.
rows.tolerance: Sum within 0.1 hour per worker-period; component-level exceptions coded
rows.failure_impact: Hours errors can distort hourly pay normalization and inclusion rules.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot per evidence policy.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit use in any calculations.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Do not collect unless required for pilot methodology.
rows.change_control: Payroll controls + Privacy approval if introduced.

rows.business_definition: Gender value used for EU core gender pay gap metrics and reporting dimensions.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from Workday gender; payroll used only for mismatch detection. Canonicalize to controlled enum; unknown/not_disclosed must be explicit.
rows.reconciliation_method: Field-level reconciliation HRIS vs payroll (when present)
rows.tolerance: Exact match when both present; missing gender for any in-scope worker is not allowed unless exception approved
rows.failure_impact: Gender is required for statutory metrics; missing/incorrect values invalidate results or bias distributions.
rows.access_control: Restricted: need-to-know. In outputs, only aggregated distributions unless explicitly approved; no worker-level gender exposure outside approved roles.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; ensure purpose limitation and minimization.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit access to gender field; audit any overrides/corrections.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Sensitive demographic processing requires explicit scope + approvals.
rows.change_control: HRIS owner + Privacy lead sign-off for any changes.

rows.business_definition: Currency of remuneration amounts (ISO 4217) for normalization and reporting context.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; canonicalize to ISO 4217.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls; valid ISO code
rows.failure_impact: Without currency code, pay comparisons and aggregations are invalid.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot metadata.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit currency handling rules.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Currency conversions must be explicitly governed (not in H02).

rows.business_definition: Base pay paid/earned in the pay period as defined by payroll earning codes mapped to base pay.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from payroll earning lines aggregated to worker-period base pay via earning_code→component mapping. HRIS may provide salary rate but is not SoR for paid amount.
rows.reconciliation_method: Payroll-anchored reconciliation of base pay totals (worker + aggregate)
rows.tolerance: Per worker-period: absolute diff <= minor_units 1 (rounding) OR <= 0.1% of amount; aggregate diff <= 0.01% unless justified
rows.failure_impact: Base pay is core remuneration input; inaccuracies directly corrupt compliance metrics and evidence.
rows.access_control: Restricted as above; amounts masked outside privileged roles
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; raw payroll reports retained per payroll controls policy; ensure deletion schedule for extracts.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit earning-code mapping changes; audit any manual adjustments and approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Earning-code mapping is a controlled artifact; changes require payroll controls approval.
rows.change_control: Payroll controls + Internal Audit awareness for mapping changes.

rows.business_definition: Periodicity/basis of base pay amount in the snapshot (e.g., per pay period).
rows.derivation_logic: Derived from payroll calendar and aggregation grain; set to 'per_pay_period' in v1 pilot.
rows.tolerance: Exact match to defined pilot grain
rows.failure_impact: Ambiguous periodicity makes reconciliation and statutory interpretation unreliable.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot metadata.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit if grain changes between runs.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Any change of grain is a material change requiring decision log entry.

rows.business_definition: Variable pay paid in the pay period (bonus/commission) as defined by mapped earning codes.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from payroll earning lines aggregated to worker-period variable pay via controlled mapping. HRIS/reward eligibility is not SoR for paid amounts.
rows.reconciliation_method: Payroll-anchored reconciliation of variable pay totals
rows.tolerance: Per worker-period: abs diff <= minor_units 1 OR <= 0.1%; aggregate diff <= 0.05% unless justified
rows.failure_impact: Variable pay is required for statutory bonus gap metrics; inaccuracies materially change outputs.
rows.access_control: Restricted as above; amounts masked outside privileged roles
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot; raw payroll evidence per policy.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit earning-code mapping changes and approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Ensure consistent inclusion/exclusion rules for variable pay (defined in methodology/reconciliation frameworks).

rows.business_definition: Allowances/one-time payments paid in the period (if in pilot scope) aggregated via mapped earning codes.
rows.derivation_logic: Primary from payroll mapped earning lines; include only if pilot scope requires allowances.
rows.tolerance: Per worker-period: abs diff <= minor_units 1 OR <= 0.1%; aggregate diff <= 0.1% unless justified
rows.failure_impact: Allowances may affect total remuneration; if excluded must be explicit with coded rationale.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot if included.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit inclusion decision and mapping changes.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Do not include allowances unless agreed in pilot scope lock.
rows.change_control: Payroll controls + Legal notified if included.

rows.business_definition: Earning code on payroll earning lines used to map to canonical pay components.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct extract; used as mapping key; must be retained for audit and explainability.
rows.reconciliation_method: Mapping reference completeness + unmapped code register
rows.tolerance: 0 unmapped earning codes for included lines (or explicitly excluded with owner-approved reason)
rows.failure_impact: Unmapped earning codes create silent pay leakage and break payroll anchoring.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain mapping keys and code lists per payroll controls policy.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit mapping table version; audit change approvals.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Earning code catalogs can be sensitive; avoid broad distribution.

rows.business_definition: Version identifier for the earning_code→pay component mapping used in the run.
rows.derivation_logic: In v1, set as an explicit version string controlled by payroll controls; referenced by snapshot/matrix rows.
rows.tolerance: Must be present; must match approved mapping version
rows.failure_impact: Without mapping version, outputs are not reproducible or auditable.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain indefinitely with evidence pack retention requirements.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit mapping version changes; link to approval artifacts.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Mapping changes require governance; do not change mid-pilot without decision log.

rows.business_definition: Immutable identifier for the sealed snapshot/run input used to tie all evidence and outputs.
rows.derivation_logic: Generated at snapshot seal time; must be carried on every downstream artifact and report.
rows.tolerance: Must be present; exact match across all outputs
rows.failure_impact: Without snapshot_id, reproducibility and audit traceability fail.
rows.access_control: Restricted to project roles; included in evidence packs
rows.retention_requirement: Retain per evidence retention policy (often multiple years).
rows.audit_requirement: Audit snapshot creation and access; immutable storage evidence.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Snapshot is the unit of evidence; treat as immutable.
rows.change_control: Change not permitted; only new snapshots.

rows.business_definition: Version identifier of Methodology v1+ used for category assignment and metric interpretation.
rows.derivation_logic: In v1, set as an explicit version string linked to H03 methodology artifact; must be carried on runs.
rows.reconciliation_method: Metadata check vs approved methodology artifact
rows.tolerance: Must be present; exact match to approved methodology version
rows.failure_impact: Without a methodology version, outputs are not defensible or reproducible.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with evidence bundle.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit methodology adoption decision reference.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Methodology changes require Legal sign-off (Validation Charter G3).

rows.business_definition: Comparable category identifier assigned per worker for metrics grouping.
rows.derivation_logic: Derived deterministically per category assignment rules + inputs; must be stable for same inputs and versions.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls for in-scope; 0 unassigned unless exception approved
rows.failure_impact: Without category_id per worker, metrics cannot be computed or defended.
rows.access_control: Restricted to project roles; avoid worker-level sharing beyond need-to-know
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with snapshot outputs as evidence.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit rule versions and override records referenced.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Category assignment governance is defined in methodology; do not treat as purely technical.
rows.change_control: Reward owner sign-off required for rule changes.

rows.business_definition: Basis used to assign category (e.g., exact/normalized/equal_value/override) for explainability.
rows.derivation_logic: Direct from category assignment output; must be present per worker.
rows.tolerance: 0 nulls for in-scope
rows.failure_impact: Missing basis breaks explainability and audit defense.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with evidence bundle.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit any changes to basis enum usage.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Used for explainability only; not a pay input.
rows.change_control: Platform engineering + Reward approval if schema changes.

rows.business_definition: Identifier of an approved override applied to category assignment (if any).
rows.derivation_logic: Present only when override basis is used; must link to governed override record.
rows.tolerance: 0 orphan override references
rows.failure_impact: Orphan overrides create untraceable changes and legal risk.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain override records per evidence policy.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit override approvals and timestamps.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Overrides require explicit approval and expiry (defined in H03).

rows.business_definition: Boolean indicating whether any override affected the worker’s category assignment.
rows.derivation_logic: Derived from presence of override_id or override basis; must be consistent.
rows.tolerance: Must match override_id presence
rows.failure_impact: Incorrect override flag impairs explainability and reviewer workflows.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with evidence bundle.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit override application logic changes (future slices).
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Used for audit and reporting flags.

rows.business_definition: Reference identifier to a confidence assessment artifact (record-level/field-level) produced by the confidence model (H05), not the score itself.
rows.derivation_logic: In v1, reserve the reference field; populate only when H05 defines artifact format. Until then, must be null.
rows.tolerance: Must be null in v1 pilot until H05 is accepted
rows.failure_impact: Premature/undefined confidence references create false assurance.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain if produced as evidence.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit introduction of confidence artifacts.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Do not compute confidence in H02; references only.

rows.business_definition: Reference identifier for an explainability trace bundle enabling worker-level trace (inputs→derivations→versions→outputs).
rows.derivation_logic: In v1, define as a required reference to an explainability walkthrough pack item per worker or sample; may be a URI/path within evidence bundle.
rows.tolerance: Must be present for sampled workers; for full population, may be present at run-level depending on pilot design
rows.failure_impact: Without explainability traces, pilot cannot satisfy Validation Charter G9 and is not defensible.
rows.retention_requirement: Retain with evidence bundle per audit requirements.
rows.audit_requirement: Audit access to trace bundles; immutable evidence storage.
rows.legal_or_usage_notes: Explainability must not leak PII beyond approved audience.
